description:
Analyze a file already uploaded to a file session and return its analysis: PDF metadata (page size/count), extracted text, image labels, color palette, quality scores, and an AI classification (productCategory, industry, designStyle, targetAudience, marketingIntent).

The file is analyzed in place from the file session's storage — no re-upload. Analysis typically takes 30–90 seconds; this tool waits up to waitSeconds and otherwise returns a pending status with an uploadId — resume with get_file_analysis. Feed the results to recommend_products to get product candidates.

fileName.description: Which file to analyze. Optional when the session has exactly one file.

fileSessionId.description: File session ID holding the uploaded file.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for completion before returning a pending status (default 60).

name: analyze_file
